# Benchmark telemetry schema

Schema version **1.0.0**, sent as the resource attribute `orangecase.schema_version` on every OTLP signal the case forwards. Machine-readable copy: [benchmark-schema.json](benchmark-schema.json). Source, version rules and the drift check: [telemetry.md appendix B](../telemetry.md#appendix-b-benchmark-schema).

## Trace shape

One trace per game. The game root span (named after the mode, e.g. `Joust Free-for-All`; attrs `game.id`, `game.kind`, `game.name`, `player.count`, `telemetry.moment_shape`, at game end `game.outcome` and `game.winner`) has the child `game.players`, and under it one `game.player` span per player (renamed `player: {name}` on the first frame; attrs `player.serial`, `player.name`). A player's moments (the warning `death_warning`, the death `player_death`, the agent's `intervention`) are sent in the shape `telemetry.moment_shape` names for the whole game: span events on the `game.player` span (`span_event`, the default), child spans `game.death_warning`, `game.player_death`, `game.intervention` (`span`), or log records with that `event_name` and the player span's trace context (`log_event`). Every moment carries `moment.id`, `player.serial`, `player.name` (once known), `game.id` and `game.kind`. The winner's `game.player` span ends with the span event `victory`. At a normal game end the root gets one `challenge.ground_truth` event per player and one `challenge.intervention_ground_truth` event per applied intervention. The agent's side of an intervention is its own trace: `agent.decision` (`decision.intervention_id`) and its child `agent.intervention.effect` (`intervention.id`), joined to the game's trace by the intervention id, which the flag service's `flagservice.write` span also carries. Per-player motion is the metric `game_player_accel_magnitude{serial, game_id}`.

## Spans and span events

| Key | Kind | On | Type | Challenges | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orangecase.challenge.start` | span_event | game root, when a challenge flag becomes active in the match |  | all | stable |
| `orangecase.challenge.end` | span_event | game root, when a challenge ends, switches or the match ends |  | all | stable |
| `game.players` | span | child of the game root |  | UC-100, UC-101 | stable |
| `game.player` | span | one per player, child of `game.players` |  | UC-100, UC-101 | stable |
| `game.death_warning` | span | child of `game.player`, shape `span` |  | UC-100 | stable |
| `game.player_death` | span | child of `game.player`, shape `span` |  | UC-100, UC-102 | stable |
| `game.intervention` | span | child of `game.player`, shape `span` |  | UC-101 | stable |
| `agent.decision` | span | agent trace |  | UC-101 | stable |
| `agent.intervention.effect` | span | child of `agent.decision` |  | UC-101 | stable |
| `flagservice.write` | span | flag service, one per write |  | UC-101 | stable |
| `death_warning` | span_event | `game.player` in shape `span_event`; log `event_name` in shape `log_event` |  | UC-100 | stable |
| `player_death` | span_event | `game.player` in shape `span_event`; log `event_name` in shape `log_event` |  | UC-100, UC-102 | stable |
| `intervention` | span_event | `game.player` in shape `span_event`; log `event_name` in shape `log_event` |  | UC-101 | stable |
| `victory` | span_event | the winner's `game.player` |  | UC-100 | stable |
| `challenge.ground_truth` | span_event | game root, one per player at a normal end |  | UC-100, UC-102 | stable |
| `challenge.intervention_ground_truth` | span_event | game root, one per applied intervention at a normal end |  | UC-101 | stable |
